newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania expects 3.2 mln potato crop in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Romania expects 3.2 mln potato crop in 1996.

text.p: Romania expects a potato crop of 3.2 million tonnes this year, some 200,000 tonnes up from 1995, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Tuesday.
It said the harvest would be higher thanks to an expanded crop area as well as higher per-hectare yields.
The private sector is expected to account for 96.1 percent of this year's potato output, CNS data showed.

Private farming has developed in post-communist Romania after a 1991 land reform law which returned up to 10 hectares of land to people whose lands had been confiscated by communists. --Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
